generation.prompt: Create an original character reference sheet for a tiny, endearingly pathetic yellow kitchen SPONGE mascot in a Korean relatable healing comic. The supplied image is STYLE reference ONLY: match its pure white background, charcoal slightly fuzzy hand-drawn wavy outlines, tiny widely spaced dot eyes, very short mouth, and extremely short thin stick arms and legs. Do NOT make another stone. Sponge is one squat soft rectangular body with rounded corners, width 1.25 times height, deliberately wobbly/squiggly perimeter with many small uneven rounded bends, charcoal gray pencil-ink edge. Pale muted buttery YELLOW flat body fill, exactly a few simple small ochre pore marks near outer corners, leave face clean; no green scouring layer, no realistic porous texture. No clothes, nose, eyelashes, fingers, shoes or anime eyes. Modest understated doodle, lovable and a little helpless. Square reference sheet, spacious 3-column 2-row arrangement, NO labels: top row front neutral standing, three-quarter listening with tiny short smile, listening while beginning to sag with one small pale blue droplet near lower edge. Bottom row saturated slumped sitting, two pale blue drips and tiny puddle; sitting tired with a tiny raised palm gesture signalling no more; same tired seated sponge turning its dot-eye gaze slightly right with a tiny attentive mouth, emotional relief understated. Keep identity, yellow hue, eye spacing and pore placement consistent; pose and sagging change slightly. No text, speech bubbles, watermarks, titles or panel borders. All negative space PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, no ivory or beige background, no paper texture. Shadows only faint neutral gray, water pale muted blue. Make the squiggly, softly rough, pathetic little silhouette clear.
